# Audit 02 — Optimization

**Audit date:** 2026-09-29 · **Reviewed commit:** `0564118` (main) · **Deployed:** `v1.0.0` (`a00803b`).

Scope: query structure, N+1 patterns, indexing, pagination, memory use, batch limits and repeated work. No load test was run against production. Measurements below are the production aggregate scale observed read-only on 2026-09-29: 1 workspace, 52 opportunities, 141 skills, 231 email imports, 231 mailbox messages, 4,887 mailbox runs, 31 evaluations, 31 reviews, 0 enrichments.

## Confirmed defects

None. Every finding below is an optional improvement or an accepted limitation; nothing observed in the query structure or schema indicates a performance risk at the observed personal scale. No query timing was measured, so this is a structural assessment, not a performance measurement.

## Missing verification

| Check                                     | Status       | Note                                                                                            |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Query timing / `EXPLAIN` on production    | NOT VERIFIED | Not executed; production load testing was out of scope. No latency claim is made for any query. |
| Memory profile of a 1 MiB IMAP body fetch | NOT VERIFIED | Intake is disabled in production; behaviour inferred from code only.                            |

## Accepted limitations

| ID     | Location                                                                                                 | Observation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| OPT-A1 | [ListReviewOpportunities.php](../../../app/Application/Review/ListReviewOpportunities.php#L47-L52)       | Queue ordering and the `recommendation`/`missing` filters are expressions over JSON columns (`JSON_EXTRACT(... '$.recommendation')`, `JSON_LENGTH(...)`), so MariaDB cannot use an index and performs a filesort over the workspace's opportunities on every page. Acceptable for hundreds–low thousands of rows; would need a persisted `displayed_recommendation` column or generated-column index only if the workspace grows by orders of magnitude. |
| OPT-A2 | [PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L118-L196)      | Discovery inserts ledger rows with one `insertOrIgnore` per message (≤100 per poll by the batch clamp). Bounded and inside one transaction.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| OPT-A3 | [DeadlineAwareImapProtocol.php](../../../app/Infrastructure/Email/DeadlineAwareImapProtocol.php#L52-L66) | The deadline-aware protocol re-times the stream and re-checks the clock per byte read (inherits the vendor's `fread(...,1)` loop). A 1 MiB body costs ~1M iterations. Deliberate trade-off recorded in ADR-004; only one raw message is in memory at a time.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| OPT-A4 | `mailbox_runs` (4,887 rows after ~4 weeks)                                                               | One row per 5-minute poll, never pruned. ~100k rows/year. The health query filters on `status`+`finished_at` but the only index is `(workspace_id, mailbox_key, started_at)` ([migration](../../../database/migrations/2026_08_30_171957_create_mailbox_runs_table.php#L32)). Still trivial at this growth; revisit with a retention policy only if operational reporting slows.                                                                         |

## Verified good practice (PASS)

- Pagination fixed at 25 with validated `page` ([OpportunityReviewController.php](../../../app/Http/Controllers/OpportunityReviewController.php#L91-L100)); filters and ordering applied in SQL before pagination.
- No N+1: `with('skills')` on the list query; `BuildOpportunityTriageInput` uses `loadMissing('skills')`; mailbox processing uses a pre-built reference map ([PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L207-L210)).
- Operational summary uses SQL aggregates and `toBase()` (no model hydration) ([BuildOperationalSummary.php](../../../app/Application/Operations/BuildOperationalSummary.php#L25-L68)).
- Bounded inputs everywhere: 1 MiB raw email, 64 KiB request/profile/cohort files, 20 000-char descriptions, 100-item cohorts, 1–100 mailbox batch.
- Existing unique indexes cover the hot joins: `(workspace_id, opportunity_id, engine_version, profile_version, input_sha256)` on evaluations; `(evaluation_id, revision)` on enrichments; `(workspace_id, mailbox_key, uid_validity, message_uid)` and the retry index on mailbox messages.
- Sequential fetch/import with immediate release of the raw string ([PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L425-L440)).

## Review limits

No production `EXPLAIN` or timing was captured. Conclusions rest on query structure, the schema, and the observed row counts; they do not establish response times.
